sources.title: Provable Robust Watermarking for AI-Generated Text
A Semantic Invariant Robust Watermark for Large Language Models

scope.fixed: Experimental fixed-vocabulary variant inspired by Unigram-Watermark. Uses unique-token scoring; not an exact paper reproduction.
scope.main: Same topics, seeds, length and cutoff across methods. Seed 0 development, seed 1 exploratory calibration, seed 2 held out.
scope.quality: Human meaning, fluency and factual-fidelity ratings must be collected. Lexical overlap is descriptive only.
scope.false_positives: Controls are unwatermarked AI text, not a human corpus. Human false-positive rate remains unmeasured.
scope.translation: Not run: the two translation models are not cached. No synthetic substitution replaces translation.
scope.semantic: Pending: dedicated semantic encoder and faithful reference implementation are not installed. Current fixed method is NOT semantic watermarking.
